brief.summary: Equity futures are slightly lower, with the S&P down about 0.1% and Nasdaq 0.15%, showing resilience despite the macro backdrop. Long-end yields are up, with the 10-year topping 5% for the first time since 2007, while the 2s10s curve is flattening and the two-year sits near 4.65%. Oil is sharply higher near $110-117 Brent, up roughly 20% this month, as the East-West pipeline remains offline and Hormuz risks persist. The Fed is expected to hike 25bp tomorrow, with market pricing above 90%; the show frames this as hawkish but potentially a policy mistake. AI/earnings tone is mixed, credit spreads are tight, and geopolitics are escalating. The overall tone is cautious risk-off, though equities remain notably resilient.
